name: Massachusetts Behavioral Health Help Line
provider: Massachusetts Behavioral Health Partnership (for the Commonwealth of Massachusetts)
description: A free, confidential help line for mental health and substance use concerns, run as a service of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. Call or text any time, 24/7 including holidays, to be connected directly to clinical help. No health insurance is required. Interpretation is available in 200+ languages; text/chat is English only.

requirements.text: Free, confidential, and no health insurance is required. Available 24/7, including holidays.
Real-time interpretation in 200+ languages by phone; text/chat is currently only available in English. Deaf or hard-of-hearing callers can use MassRelay at 711.

first_step.title: Call or text the Behavioral Health Help Line
first_step.detail: Call or text 833-773-2445, any time, day or night. It is free and you do not need health insurance.
